name: Dagger: Yuushiki no Himemiko
source:
In the battle known as the PreWar, 
a demonic spell was cast to resurrect the fallen. 
For one week only, they would live again. 
In that remaining time, what would be thought, 
and what could be done? 

That moment of true death. 
Love weighs heavier on the heart than ever. 

The 3rd side story to the DAGGER saga.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE160842.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在这场被称为“战前”的战役中，
施放了一个恶魔咒语来复活倒下的人。
只有一周的时间，他们就能再次活下去。
在剩下的时间里，会想到什么，
可以做什么？

真正死亡的那一刻。
爱情比以往任何时候都更沉重地压在心上。

DAGGER传奇的第三个支线故事。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE160842.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
